storage_proposal.canonical_format: E.164 plus sign followed by 8-15 ASCII digits; exact candidate country validity pending
storage_proposal.unique_index_scope: UNIQUE for every non-null canonical value, irrespective of is_active or roles

write_protocol.source_row_identity: immutable account pk, literal legacy 09 number, is_active; no alias fallback
preconditions: no duplicate account IDs or canonical targets
canonical proposal matches strict source candidate
active status and legacy mobile unchanged
database unique index covers all non-null canonical identities
write_protocol.atomic_db_requirement: select_for_update row lock or equivalent CAS and DB unique constraint within one transaction; catch conflicts and fail closed
write_protocol.conflict_behavior: return constant reason, no account takeover, partial batch or implicit retry
write_protocol.rollback_behavior: preserve legacy field and active state, clear only shadow when version matches, increment revision; actual database backup and retention approved separately
write_protocol.batch_strategy: bounded deterministic id order, one ACID transaction per approved chunk; abort whole chunk on any stale/collision
write_protocol.idempotency: repeated old-version claim must not write; same claim at latest version reports already claimed

offline_simulation.scope: single-process in-memory lock protecting synthetic fixtures; not database concurrency proof
offline_simulation.report: counts, statuses and constant reason codes only

stop_conditions: unknown or stale account row version
changed legacy username, activation state or assigned roles
invalid canonical E.164 candidate or ambiguous foreign national input
any canonical collision including inactive and deleted identities
duplicate IDs, invalid stored identities or deleted placeholders
missing OTP key/session replay continuity and rate-limit proof
unreviewed dynamic clients and security acceptance absent
